summary: Feed c038_link_span is severely degraded: SPAN destination oversubscribed (2.04 Gbps mirrored into 1 Gbps port) causing 50.96% loss at DIST-SW-02 Gi1/0/48 plus 0.66% loss on link to NPB-01. NDR receives only ~49% of packets, halving detection coverage.

findings.root_cause: SPAN destination oversubscription at DIST-SW-02 Gi1/0/48: SPAN session should copy 21,846,420 packets from Gi1/0/1 (2.04 Gbps) but Gi1/0/48 is only 1 Gbps and sent only 10,714,260 packets, discarding 11,132,100 packets on output (average load 100% of 1 Gbps, bursts higher) = 50.96% loss at source
findings.impact_on_tool: NDR (needs both directions and full payload, 10 Gbps port) receives less than half of required traffic. Flows truncated, sessions incomplete, IDS signatures and anomaly detection miss ~51% of packets, forensics unreliable and alerts suppressed

recommended_fix.why: Passive TAP delivers line-rate copy without SPAN buffer contention or 1G destination policing. Eliminates 51% oversubscription loss at source and preserves both directions/full payload needed by NDR; aggregate via NPB with adequate capacity (10G).

findings.root_cause: Additional 0.66% loss on link between DIST-SW-02 Gi1/0/48 (SPAN destination) and NPB-01 port 1 (input): Gi1/0/48 sent 10,714,260 packets but NPB-01 port 1 saw only 10,643,460 (70,800 packets lost on cable/optic or unmonitored device)
findings.impact_on_tool: Further degrades NDR completeness after SPAN loss; adds gaps in already halved feed, causing additional flow reassembly failures and missed detections

recommended_fix.why: Link-level loss indicates physical layer or intermediate device issue (optic, cable, patch, media converter) that must be fixed after TAP replacement to ensure lossless delivery to NDR
